coordinate_system: +Y up; +Z front; +X object right. Angles use local joint axes.
notes: 盆、根和树干底部固定；枝梢与叶团使用分层风动。树叶不凭空增减。

states.name: 无风
states.visual_description: Neutral upright tree, exact reference branches and foliage crowns.

states.name: 左风阵
states.visual_description: Trunk base and pot remain still; upper branches bend gently to IMAGE LEFT and same leaf crowns lag slightly farther left.

states.name: 右风阵
states.visual_description: Upper branches and leaf crowns lean gently to IMAGE RIGHT, same tree topology and leaves. Pot stationary.

states.name: 余振
states.visual_description: Upper trunk nearly upright, branch tips show small returning bend with leaf crowns lagging opposite; same rooted silhouette.

generation_policy: 生成3D使用baseline中性造型，动态状态仅用于灯光/关节/形变设定；不对各状态分别生成模型。
reference_accuracy: AI概念关键帧；角度与关节约束以参数为准，不是同一3D网格的精确渲染。
clip_preview: 目录页的关键帧轮播，不是骨骼动画或物理动画。

wind_clip.note: 花箱/花盆/根固定；主摆动与叶尖余振分层。
